targets.triangleExpansionLaw: sqrt(local-area-share) homothety from strict first prior-interior seed or midpoint of a completed shared edge
targets.positiveProgressContact: First seed has strict positive margin inside actual completed prior P. Every later triangle shares an entire nonzero edge with an earlier completed triangle. Every partial triangle contains its seed. Ordered positive area weights sum to1. At phase, foot triangle union equals original P clipped at cutX. Body has one positive vertical interval in every critical-X strip and positive cutX cross-section; monotone X-prefix stays attached.
